in_marathi.name: Niju
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niju हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Niju is a Sanskrit name that means 'New Moon'. In Hindu mythology, the new moon signifies the beginning of a new cycle and is associated with renewal, fresh starts, and transformation.
